summary: Suicide deaths of IIT Delhi students; caste discrimination allegations; postmortem confirming hanging; academic failure stress noted; no evidence of caste-based discrimination found; scope of Section 174 CrPC vs Section 154 CrPC; High Court correctly declined mandamus for FIR registration; departmental inquiry conducted; mental health concerns addressed; National Task Force recommended.
legal_provisions_cited: Article 226 and 227 of the Constitution of India
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment upholding no FIR registration affirmed; National Task Force to address student mental health concerns established.
